reviewer: GenUI managed_restore_ops_review; independent of operation preparation
verdict: no blocking findings in the exact prepared bounded restore operation
scope: Preparation review only; no AWS calls by reviewer and no restore acceptance inferred.
checks: Distinct fixed snapshot and target identities
Available encrypted source on exact engine/storage
Matching private subnet group and security group only
Password is not read or reset
Task execution and migration roles preserved
Exact reviewed helper and immutable image
Source endpoint binding and actual task completion
Actual source manifest passes and hash recomputes
Explicit two/four-hour budget bounds and preserved expiry
No reseeding or IAM expansion before comparison
required_execution_evidence: Before restore, the exact snapshot must be available and identify the expected source DB/engine/version/encryption/KMS key.

Before the restored manifest, verify the actual restored instance is available and matches private subnet/security/parameter group,16.13,20GiB,gp3,encrypted key,CA,small single-AZ,IAM and explicit disable flags.
Run exact same reviewed task definition with only the actual restored PGHOST override, preserving password execution-secret injection; no migration or seeding first.
Bind actual restored endpoint and new DB resource ID to stopped exit-zero task and compare complete validated manifests plus their digests.

Observe owned tasks stopped, delete only exact temporary restored DB/snapshot and its automated backups, verify absence, then deregister the temporary definition; preserve source DB/shared network/parameter group/key/secret and original expiry.
Unknown outcomes require exact-ID reconciliation; cleanup deadline/escalation does not automatically enforce itself.
limitations: The source instance has AutoMinorVersionUpgrade=true; the prepared trial restore explicitly disables it. This review does not claim the source flag is disabled.
No restored endpoint/resource exists at review time. Encryption/version inherited from the snapshot require actual post-restore confirmation.
This is initial role/schema foundation recovery, not later application/audit recovery or APP-008 RLS acceptance.
